description:
## Problem
Every shipped `*_tuned.yaml` looks equally trustworthy. Nothing tells a user that the Databricks, Snowflake and DuckDB templates have never been measured against `notuning`, or that the ClickHouse decisions hold only at SF1.

## Change
Implement the owner's D3 decision (`tuning-evidence-tuned-mode-promise-20261008`). Assuming D3 picks the label:
- A machine-readable evidence state per template: measured-keep, measured-adjust or unmeasured. Each state records scale, memory rung, engine version and a link to the evidence.
- Initial states: ClickHouse TPC-H, SSB and TPC-DS are measured at SF1 and provisional; every other template is unmeasured.
- The result records the state under `platform.tuning`.
- The console prints a one-line warning when a run uses an unmeasured template.
- The results Explorer and reports show the state.

## Decision gates
- Where the state lives: prefer one registry file, so a measurement updates one place, over a block in each template. If a per-template block is chosen instead, say why.
- The state is metadata and must not enter `requested_config_hash`. If the design forces it in, stop and ask, because changing the hash splits existing comparisons.
- If D3 chose quarantine, rewrite this item to match before starting.

## Guardrails (must preserve)
- Runs are never blocked because of the state; there is no hard gate.
- `requested_config_hash` values of existing templates do not change.

## Process guardrails
- One PR per item against `develop`, via the AGENTS.md worktree flow (`make worktree-claim BRANCH=...`, `make agent-write-preflight`).
- Verification ladder: `uv run -- python -m pytest -m fast -q`, `uv run -- ruff check .`, `uv run -- ruff format --check .` and `uv run -- ty check`. Then `make pr-preflight` and `make pr-open`.
- Stage explicit paths; never `git add -A`.
- Re-read every file:line anchor before editing. Anchors are from develop 5ca12e6ca.
